Messages.Author: David Pontes
Messages.Body:
Good evening. These questions have troubled my mind recently:

- The Mehemet of the Ahl-i-Batin may burn a disc. card and a
blood with a (D) action. Can he do just one of these effects (e.g. just
burn a blood)?

- If I have n minons with sup. obfuscate, can I modify the
action of one of them with n Cloak the Gatherings?

- [previously debated, I know, but I still don't know the answer] are
bleed reductions due to Telepathic Counters go negative? (e.g. bleed for
1-> reduce by 2 -> play Bonding. Result:?)

- Are "(D) bleed at +X" cards able to be used agains other meths
other than your prey? (if the card itself doesn't say it, that is)

Thank you.

David Pontes

8[

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
David Pontes <l41...@alfa.ist.utl.pt> writes:
> Good evening. These questions have troubled my mind recently:

> - The Mehemet of the Ahl-i-Batin may burn a disc. card and a
>blood with a (D) action. Can he do just one of these effects (e.g. just
>burn a blood)?

Judging by the way Cryptic Mission is handled (esp. the superior) version,
you can use Mehemet's special ability to burn a blood on a vampire without
burning a skill card - based purely on card text (as the ruling on Cryptic
Mission relies on card text over card concept).

And, in any case, you could burn a skill card possesed by an empty vampire,
who would ignore the burn blood effect (as usual).

> - If I have n minons with sup. obfuscate, can I modify the
>action of one of them with n Cloak the Gatherings?

Yes. (This is official)

> - [previously debated, I know, but I still don't know the answer] are
>bleed reductions due to Telepathic Counters go negative? (e.g. bleed for
>1-> reduce by 2 -> play Bonding. Result:?)

Yes, they can go negative. Negative bleeds are unsuccessful and burn no
pool from the target. (e.g. 1 -> reduce by 2 -> bonding => bleed for 0)

> - Are "(D) bleed at +X" cards able to be used agains other meths
>other than your prey? (if the card itself doesn't say it, that is)

Yes. (Ofiicially, this is just a ruling, but it is actually errata to
the section of the rules regarding who can be the target of a bleed.)

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
David Pontes <l41...@alfa.ist.utl.pt> writes:
>On 25 Nov 1996, L. Scott Johnson wrote:
>> David Pontes <l41...@alfa.ist.utl.pt> writes:
>> > - The Mehemet of the Ahl-i-Batin may burn a disc. card and a
>> >blood with a (D) action. Can he do just one of these effects (e.g. just
>> >burn a blood)?
>> Judging by the way Cryptic Mission is handled (esp. the superior) version,
>> you can use Mehemet's special ability to burn a blood on a vampire without
>> burning a skill card - based purely on card text (as the ruling on Cryptic
>> Mission relies on card text over card concept).
> What ruling? I'm afraid I'm not aware of that one...

That Cryptic Mission can be directed at an empty vampire (who will ignore
the burn blood effect), and that the superior version will still give the
acting vampire a blood, even though the target didn't have one to lose.

So (assuming precedent is going to be used for this new card), even though
the blood is lost (in concept) "because" the skill card was burned, the
blood will still be lost even if there is no skill card to burn.

(This would also follow from the "partial effects of cards may be used"
rule from the Anarch Troublemaker ruling - even though that rule was not
used in the Second Tradition ruling).

>> > - If I have n minons with sup. obfuscate, can I modify the
>> >action of one of them with n Cloak the Gatherings?
>> Yes. (This is official)
> Are you sure? I've inspected the rulebook a while after posting
>this and it read:
> "A Minion cannot use 2 identical Action Mod. to affect the same
>action".
> IMO what happens with cloak the gathering is that n vamps *play*
>it but only one *uses* it, therefore preventing this move. But if it's
>official...

Nah - they each use/play their own to modify the acting minion's stealth.
"use" and "play" are two terms for the same thing (except that you can also
"use" a card in play).

From: aa...@cats.ucsc.edu (Thomas R Wylie)

Subject: DESIGN TEAM RULINGS: 5/9/95
Date: 9 May 1995 07:17:48 GMT
Message-ID: <3on4us$l...@darkstar.UCSC.EDU>

2) Sections 7.2.2 and 14.4 have conflicting statement about how
many times an action modifier may be played during a single
action. Section 7.2.2 is correct; the same *minion* may only play
a given action modifier once, but potentially each minion
controlled by a player may use the same card to modify an action.
This means that all of your vampires may play Cloak the Gathering
on the same action (assuming they all have superior obfuscate),
that an action modifier can be repeated if Mask of 1000 Faces is
used, and so on.

Thank you. Good to be back.
